scope: SQL-free storage correctness, lifetimes and admission bounds; not a performance comparison

coverage: range access including actual page boundaries and nonzero mapping offsets
budget, conflicts, empty data, revision exhaustion
failure before publication preserves prior version
failure after publication reports uncertain durability
child exit before publication preserves prior version and releases writer lock

initial_run.difference: Only test-flow.c changed: page-boundary fixture now uses actual OS page size and distinct per-page contents

limitations: Linux AArch64 only; macOS not executed
No actual power-loss or disk-fault testing
Logical payload budget excludes page rounding, page cache, disk retention, OS sockets and client allocations
Unpublished files left by crashes are ignored but not automatically collected
Synchronous filesystem operations can delay other connections and timeout enforcement
Single-threaded control API with one cooperating process writer lock per directory
Whole-object replacement, no multi-object transaction or payload checksum
Stored files must not be mutated in place by external writers
Pure-authored external effects and automatic path optimization remain unimplemented
